request.style: English, acoustic singer-songwriter, warm unhurried male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, soft brushed snare, light cello, intimate and reassuring, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The lamps were low in the upper room
The bread was broken, the night came soon
He told his friends that he had to go
Their faces fell and their hearts sank low

[Chorus]
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Trust in God, and trust in me
In my Father's house there are many rooms
I am the way and the truth and the life

[Verse]
I go ahead to make it ready there
A place for you, prepared with care
I will come back and take you to myself
So that where I am, you may be also

[Chorus]
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Trust in God, and trust in me
In my Father's house there are many rooms
I am the way and the truth and the life

[Verse]
Then Thomas spoke for all the rest
With a worried heart and an honest guess
Lord, we do not know where you are going
How can we know the way?

[Bridge]
I am the way and the truth and the life
No one comes to the Father except through me

[Chorus]
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Trust in God, and trust in me
In my Father's house there are many rooms
I am the way and the truth and the life

[Outro]
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Trust in God, and trust in me
